summary: Modify an existing 'Game Theory in Business Strategy' website by completely removing all 'Models/Explore Models' content and refocusing navigation and pages on About, Interactive Game Simulator, Case Studies, Learning Resources, and Contact/Feedback.
architectural_notes: Purge all Models-related UI, routes/pages, components, and references across HTML/CSS/JS (React) to ensure zero remaining mentions and smooth navigation after deletion.

existing_features.title: Completely remove the “Models” / “Explore Models” section from site navigation, including desktop and mobile navigation, and ensure no navigation item routes to “/models”.
Remove the “/models” route and page from the router and application code, including deleting/retiring the InteractiveModelsPage and ensuring the app compiles and runs without it.

Update the homepage to remove any “Explore Models” CTA/button and replace homepage primary actions with exactly: “Play Interactive Game”, “Start Learning”, and “View Case Studies”, while keeping the hero title “Game Theory for Strategic Business Decisions.”
Remove all internal links, buttons, and references that send users to “/models” or mention “Models”, including the Case Studies page call-to-action and the footer quick links.

Delete or retire all model-related React components under `frontend/src/components/models/**` (and any related imports), ensuring no “models” calculators remain in the codebase or bundled output and that the rest of the site (Simulator, About, Case Studies, Learning Resources, Contact/Feedback) continues to function.

Refocus site flow and user-facing labels to emphasize only: About Game Theory, Interactive Game Simulator, Case Studies, Learning Resources, and Contact/Feedback; remove or de-emphasize other top-level navigation items that conflict with this focus (e.g., remove “Quiz” from the primary navigation if present).

Audit and remove model-related learning assets and references, including any downloadable resource files or copy that explicitly centers “Interactive Models” (e.g., `frontend/public/assets/downloads/interactive-models-summaries.md`) so that the site has zero references to “Models”.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove all 'Models/Explore Models' navigation, buttons, pages/routes/components, links, and references; update homepage CTAs and site flow to focus on About, Interactive Game Simulator, Case Studies, Learning Resources, and Contact/Feedback while keeping the title 'Game Theory for Strategic Business Decisions'.
